# ChatGPT Desktop Librarian

Purpose: A local-first ChatGPT Desktop, Codex, and Hermes integration for an existing Markdown knowledge base. ChatGPT Desktop receives explicit read-only retrieval through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel; Codex and Hermes share deterministic write governance. Routine low-risk changes may auto-apply. Destructive, conflicting, low-confidence, control-file, raw-source mutation, major-rewrite, and other risky changes are staged for selective human review.

Canonical architecture:
- User's Markdown folder / Obsidian vault: source of truth.
- Hermes / llm-wiki: reasoning, research, synthesis, organization.
- Agentic Librarian: deterministic write policy, proposals, stale checks, receipts.
- QMD (optional): retrieval/index and duplicate preflight only; never authoritative.
- Git (optional): transaction checkpoint/audit only.
- ChatGPT Desktop (optional): explicit read-only MCP retrieval through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel; not native account memory.

No required Docker, database, daemon, web UI, QMD, Obsidian, or Git.
No telemetry or hosted service.

Primary runtime rule: use librarian_change instead of write_file/patch for governed knowledge files.

Important trust rules:
- model risk flags can escalate but never bypass deterministic checks;
- proposal application is hash-bound and refuses stale bases;
- same-machine Librarian transactions use a root-keyed local lock plus optimistic base-hash rechecks;
- pending proposal bodies live outside the knowledge root;
- every staged proposal returns a compact review card that the active agent must show immediately, including readable proposed-versus-current and preview-safe current-article HTML pages, a color-coded diff (green additions, red deletions, black context), visible small-file before/after content (especially deletions), a short approve/reject decision, and full diffs on request;
- direct Hermes write_file/patch attempts inside the root are blocked by default;
- shell guarding is conservative defense-in-depth, not an OS sandbox.

Start here:
- scripts/chatgpt_desktop_mcp.py - QMD-preferred, read-only MCP server for ChatGPT Desktop.
- docs/chatgpt-desktop.md - ChatGPT Desktop connector setup and verification.
- README.md — human overview, installation, usage.
- AGENTS.md — coding-agent invariants and contribution instructions.
- skills/librarian/SKILL.md — runtime Hermes workflow.
- skills/codex-librarian/SKILL.md — runtime Codex workflow.
- scripts/codex_librarian.py — Codex adapter sharing the policy core and proposal/receipt store with Hermes.
- docs/architecture.md — components and transaction state machine.
- docs/configuration.md — settings and autonomy modes.
- docs/hermes-llm-wiki.md — how to wrap the built-in llm-wiki skill.
- docs/memory-architecture.md — reference architecture for Hermes + Obsidian + QMD + Librarian memory.
- docs/obsidian-qmd.md — canonical Obsidian + optional QMD pattern.
- docs/security.md — threat model and trust boundaries.
- docs/troubleshooting.md — diagnosis/recovery.
- schemas.py — agent-facing tool contracts.
- librarian_core/policy.py — deterministic risk classifier.
- librarian_core/service.py — transaction/proposal state machine.

Testing:
python -m compileall -q .
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python scripts/check_public_repo.py
hermes plugins doctor . --ci  # when Hermes is installed
